scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d && concurrently "pnpm -r --parallel dev" "sleep 2 && pnpm db:seed"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm -F database exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: pnpm -F database exec prisma migrate reset --force && pnpm db:seed
scripts.e2e: docker-compose up -d && pnpm -F api test:e2e && docker-compose down
